C10 and C02 also delegate presidential statutory authority, but lack the child's distinctive opening and are less closely matched in structure and phrasing.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"it is hereby ordered, in the interest of the internal management of the Government, as follows","parent_excerpt":"it is hereby ordered, in the interest of the internal management of the Government, as follows","explanation":"Distinctive introductory language is reproduced verbatim."},{"child_excerpt":"The Secretary of State is hereby authorized and directed to perform the functions of the President under the International Children's Emergency Fund Assistance Act of 1948 and under the Greek-Turkish Assistance Act of 1948","parent_excerpt":"The Secretary of Commerce shall perform and exercise the functions, duties, powers, authority, and discretion ... vested in the President by sections 3, 4, 18(c), and 18(d) of the Rubber Act of 1948","explanation":"Both assign presidential functions under newly enacted legislation to a designated cabinet secretary, with the statute and responsible department adapted to the new program."}]}
